title: Soul eater
description: A simple Qol mod that adds back the NEU feature of being able to view the level and dungeon floor of the souls in any necromancy item
body:
# **Soul eater**
A simple and lightweight mod that aims to bring back the NEU feature that ws lost due to hypixel updating to 1.21+
The mod allows you to view the dungeon floor that a soul inside a necromancey item was dropped from
### Support all dungeon floors (f1 - m7)
**The mod works with all necromancey items**

This includes:
  1. Reaper scythe
  2. Nrcromancer Sword
  3. Summoning Ring
